user_confirmed.purpose: Experiment whether AI agents can develop an AI-friendly DBMS informed by open-source systems; early implementation, final disk relational DBMS goal stated publicly
user_confirmed.database_boundary: one database and one shared transaction domain; disk tables and optional disk partitions

implementation_defaults.b0_candidate_os: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS (DEV0 harness locally tested; not engine support qualification)
implementation_defaults.b0_candidate_toolchain: Rust/cargo 1.95.0 pinned and built for DEV0; see dev0-validation.json
implementation_defaults.disk_data: larger-than-memory with bounded buffer and locator cache
implementation_defaults.index_scope: LOCAL; optional GLOBAL across disk partitions
implementation_defaults.first_global_physical_layout: one native non-partitioned B+tree per index
implementation_defaults.disk_commit: durable COW data/index/locator pages before common commit WAL; atomic complete view publish
implementation_defaults.offline_ddl_first: database-wide close-admission then drain then shadow generation switch
implementation_defaults.disk_timing: DEV3 required before DEV4 engine-consuming SQL implementation/integration; dev4-independent-frontend.md permits narrowly scoped independent frontend/reference development after leaf freeze; advanced disk optimization may follow measured need
implementation_defaults.development_order: test -> foundation -> SQL-free durable kernel -> DISK storage baseline -> embedded SQL -> server -> clients; COMM/PART/NG are explicit branches
implementation_defaults.checkpoint: exact committed immutable generation selected by durable manifest/CURRENT; no fixed two-full-image requirement

qualification_profile.applicability: Current disk-engine capability only; public research preview does not imply production readiness.
qualification_profile.performance_numbers: Measured under declared workload and durability; no inherited performance claims.

B0: host/CI image digest pin and protected CI qualification remain pending; toolchain and Cargo.lock are pinned for DEV0
H1: page format, generation owner/GC, actual sync contract
H2: encoded key sizes, index layout and NULL/collation vectors
EXTERNAL_RELEASE: customer workload SLO and exact feature/driver/Linux qualification manifest
